title: Randomized Integer Word-RAM 3SUM Conjecture
exact_target: Must exact three-sum testing on bounded integers resist every always-correct randomized algorithm whose worst-case expected exponent is strictly below two?

sources.citation: Abboud and Vassilevska Williams, Popular Conjectures Imply Strong Lower Bounds for Dynamic Problems (2014), Conjecture 1; KPP (2019) for Las Vegas convention.
